parameters.query:
-- Incident Automation DB — Outages_data (newest first by epoch).
SELECT 'Outages_data' AS _mysql_source, o.*
FROM `Outages_data` AS o
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN CONCAT(IFNULL(o.create_epoch_date_time, '')) REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
      THEN CAST(o.create_epoch_date_time AS DECIMAL(24, 6))
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(IFNULL(o.create_epoch_date_time, '') AS CHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(CAST(o.create_epoch_date_time AS CHAR)) REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
      THEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(TRIM(CAST(o.create_epoch_date_time AS CHAR)), 1, 19), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'))
    ELSE 0
  END DESC,
  CAST(o.incident_no AS UNSIGNED) DESC
LIMIT 150;

nodes.name: MySQL: Outages_data
nodes.notes: Newest 150 Outages_data rows (epoch sort). Raise LIMIT in query if reports miss old months.

parameters.query:
-- Maps to `All_update_threads`: Incident_no, Inc_update_no, Slack_update_threads, slack_update_channels.
-- No `id` column: order by incident then Slack thread ts (stored as string like 1693214242.826059).
SELECT 'All_update_threads' AS _mysql_source, t.*
FROM `All_update_threads` AS t
ORDER BY t.Incident_no DESC, CAST(t.Slack_update_threads AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) DESC
LIMIT 18;
